From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmehealth.com>, Rashida Khan <rashida.khan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Acme Health kickoff & next steps

Hi Alex / Rashida —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to hear more about the integration goals for Acme Health (real-time triage, on-prem storage controls, and strict audit trails). Quick recap + proposed next steps below.

Call highlights
- Primary use case: triage assistant for nurse intake; latency SLOs <150ms for short prompts.
- Data residency: must keep patient identifiers behind customer VPC; Redwood Private is the likely path.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + audit logs required for procurement.

Proposed next steps
1) Technical deep dive + sandbox demo (45m) — two windows I can offer: Tue 4/6 9:00–9:45am PT or Wed 4/7 12:30–1:15pm PT. Please confirm which works for you and any internal stakeholders to include.
2) Security intake — looping in Priya (cc). She can run through the intake form and artifacts we typically share.
3) Mutual action plan — I attached a draft MAP (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) and a short pre-call checklist to speed the demo.

Ask for this thread: can you confirm the best attendee for procurement (PO / legal) and whether SSO (SAML) matters in the pilot? If you prefer, we can move procurement convo to a separate thread.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx, pre-call-checklist.pdf

Thanks — I’ll hold those two demo slots while you confirm.

—
Vivek Kulkarni | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: Acme Health kickoff & next steps

Vivek —

Thanks for the recap, that looks good. We’re aligned on use case and compliance needs. I can do Tue 4/6 9:00am PT for the demo with our lead engineer (Samir Patel) and myself. Rashida (cc) will own procurement and legal.

Quick notes from our side:
- SSO: yes, SAML is required for production; not necessary for the early sandbox but needs to be in the MAP.
- Data residency: we’ll need guidance on VPC peering options.

Rashida, looping you in — can you confirm who on legal should be included and whether procurement prefers an NDA before sharing any PHI examples?

Thanks,
Alex
